content: The bamboo bends before the howling wind, and so it survives the hurricane unbowed.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Zhu zi jing shen (竹之精神) — Classical Taoist Nature Lore
explanation: In an alpine storm, the brittle pine snaps in two because its rigid wood tries to fight the wind. The hollow bamboo yields, bends flat to the soil, lets the tempest roar overhead, and springs back upright toward the sun once the clouds clear. Flexibility is sovereign invulnerability.
practicalInsight: When your plans or schedule are disrupted today, yield gracefully. Bend like the bamboo instead of snapping your peace.
reflectionPrompt: Where is your stubborn refusal to adapt creating unnecessary agony in your daily life?
